item.title: Book Review | A Raconteur Unravels The Mysteries Of Internet
item.description: Some of the sharpness of his views comes from this feeling of being a misfit in the mainstream. He doesn’t find “cringe”, for instance, cringeworthy: For him, it’s a form of courage, an acknowledgment from its makers that something uncomfortable does exist, and coming to terms with it

item.title: Krishna Shastri Devulapalli | A Thousand Splendid Sons (And Fathers)
item.description: One: because, had my grandfather been around, he would have laughed very hard at the brain-dead reimagination of his song. Two, and, more importantly, I believe there’s a time and a place (by which I mean public or private) to stand up for one’s family, living or dead.
